Name: Dust Sprite and Blue Squid Pet
Author: EnbyFelix
Description: Adds two retextures of the cat for Alternative Textures, the Dust Sprite and the Blue Squid. I always thought the dust sprites/dust spirits were adorable, and I always wanted one for a pet. So now you can! Also the blue squid is cute too, so I made a texture for that one as well. No, it doesn't go in the water, but the vanilla one doesn't either so it is fine, it is a land squid. They both replace the cat, and they will both still meow.
